# Mobile-First Design

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Mobile-First Design

Mobile-first design means starting with CSS for the smallest screens and then gradually adding styles for larger devices.

![Mobile First Design](data:image/png;base64,)

This approach:

- Improves design efficiency and readability on mobile.
- Keeps code cleaner and more manageable.
- Ensures faster load times for mobile users.

Let's see how.
